name: Philadelphia Birding Hotspots
note: Coordinates are approximate (parking / main entrance area). Verify on eBird before visiting.

properties.name: John Heinz NWR at Tinicum
properties.birds: Waterfowl, herons & egrets, shorebirds, bald eagle, marsh wren, least bittern
properties.tip: Walk the impoundment loop from the visitor center; low tide on the Darby Creek side brings shorebirds.

properties.name: Bartram's Garden
properties.birds: 300+ species recorded: warblers, wood ducks, herons, bald eagles on the Schuylkill
properties.tip: Check the tidal marsh and river overlook; one of the city's first post-DDT eagle nests was here.

properties.name: Pennypack Park – North / Environmental Center
properties.birds: Warblers, vireos, thrushes, belted kingfisher, woodpeckers
properties.tip: Start at the Environmental Center on Verree Rd; the feeders and creek trail are reliable.

properties.name: Pennypack on the Delaware
properties.birds: Gulls, cormorants, osprey, ducks on the river, meadow sparrows
properties.tip: Scan the river from the trail; the meadows are good for sparrows in fall.

properties.name: Morris Arboretum
properties.birds: Migrant songbirds, raptors, Wissahickon Creek species
properties.tip: Admission required. The wetland and meadow sections are the birdiest.

properties.name: Carpenter's Woods
properties.birds: Classic spring warbler trap: 30+ warbler species possible in May
properties.tip: Go early on May mornings after a south wind; listen near the Sparrow Rd entrance.

properties.name: Wissahickon Valley Park (Valley Green)
properties.birds: Woodpeckers, thrushes, warblers, kingfisher, wintering ducks on the creek
properties.tip: Forbidden Drive from Valley Green to Kitchens Ln is the most-birded stretch.

properties.name: Andorra Natural Area & Meadow
properties.birds: Field sparrows, indigo bunting, bluebirds, migrant warblers
properties.tip: Pair the meadow with the woods around the Tree House environmental center.

properties.name: Schuylkill Center for Environmental Education
properties.birds: Forest songbirds, raptors, owls
properties.tip: Free trails; the pond and fields edge are productive.

properties.name: Houston Meadow
properties.birds: Sparrows, bluebirds, swallows, raptors overhead
properties.tip: Restored meadow off Forbidden Drive — great for fall sparrows.

properties.name: FDR Park
properties.birds: Herons, egrets, waterfowl, migrant songbirds, gulls
properties.tip: Check the lakes and the wooded edges near the Meadow Lake boathouse.

properties.name: The Woodlands (cemetery)
properties.birds: Migrant warblers, thrushes, kinglets, hawks
properties.tip: An urban migrant trap minutes from Drexel's campus.

properties.name: Laurel Hill Cemetery
properties.birds: Migrant songbirds, raptors along the Schuylkill
properties.tip: Mature trees on the bluff draw migrants; check gate hours.

properties.name: Tacony Creek Park
properties.birds: Creek-side songbirds, herons, kingfisher, woodpeckers
properties.tip: Follow the trail along the creek; less crowded than Wissahickon.

properties.name: Glen Foerd on the Delaware
properties.birds: River ducks, bald eagle, gulls, migrant songbirds
properties.tip: Scan the confluence of the Poquessing and the Delaware.

properties.name: Fort Mifflin
properties.birds: Marsh birds, shorebirds, raptors near the river
properties.tip: Admission for the fort; the surrounding marsh edges are the draw.

properties.name: Cobbs Creek Park
properties.birds: Woodland songbirds, hawks, creek species
properties.tip: 851 acres in West Philly; the environmental center area is a good start.

properties.name: Manayunk Canal Towpath
properties.birds: Waterbirds, kingfisher, swallows, migrant songbirds
properties.tip: Flat, easy walk between the canal and the Schuylkill.

properties.name: Schuylkill River Park / Trail
properties.birds: Migrants passing along the river, cormorants, gulls
properties.tip: An underrated Center City migrant spot — easiest to reach without a car.

properties.name: Awbury Arboretum
properties.birds: ~126 species: woodpeckers, sparrows, geese, occasional owls
properties.tip: Free and open daily in Germantown.
